title: Index kWh of a Block and Index or Holdover Cycle - C&I Index Line Corrections
content:
For Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, the index kWh of the index line correction follow the cycle and the structure: a cycle of fewer than 28 billing days that began on or before the contract end date on a block and index contract carries the metered kWh above the block kWh per cycle prorated by its billing days over 30; any other cycle that began on or before the contract end date on a block and index contract carries the metered kWh above the block kWh per cycle, none when they do not exceed it; every other cycle, a real-time index cycle or any holdover cycle, carries all of its metered kWh.

- **Metered kWh** are the kWh on all of the cycle's energy lines together.
- **Prorated block** is the block kWh per cycle multiplied by the cycle's billing days and divided by 30; the index kWh are the metered kWh less that prorated block, and none when the metered kWh do not exceed it.
- **Began on or before the contract end date** is judged on the cycle's billing period start; a holdover cycle begins after the contract end date.

| Structure | Cycle | Index kWh |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | in term, fewer than 28 billing days | metered kWh above the prorated block |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | in term, 28 billing days or more | metered kWh above the block kWh per cycle |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | in term | all metered kWh |
| any structure | holdover cycle | all metered kWh |

## Cases (hypothetical, block of 250000 kWh per cycle)

| Cycle | Billing days | Metered kWh | Index kWh |
|---|---|---|---|
| Block and Index, in term | 31 | 310000 | 60000 |
| Block and Index, in term | 25 | 310000 | 310000 less 208333.33: 101666.67 |
| Block and Index, in term | 31 | 240000 | none |
| Block and Index, holdover | 30 | 310000 | 310000 |
| Real-Time Index, in term | 30 | 400000 | 400000 |
